svg.title: Slot numbering scheme – side-bay-position-level
svg.text: Slot id = SIDE - BAY - POSITION - LEVEL example: L-03-2-5 = side L, bay 3, 2nd crate position in the bay, level 5
crane aisle 1 500 – crane rail along the centre line
x (along the aisle, 0 = I/O transfer point)
bay numbers 01 … 14 count from the I/O end; position 1 = crate nearer the I/O, 2 = farther
Front view of bay 03, side L (from the aisle) – schematic
bay between two upright frames, from the I/O end
crate position inside the bay (1 = nearer the I/O)
beam level, L1 0.45 m … L7 7.95 m fork level
Rules: the id never changes when stock moves; label + bar code on every front beam;
the WMS (item 4) holds slot → load → lot; the crane PLC gets x / z / side from the slot table.
EXAMPLE – check the AS/RS supplier's documentation
Digital twin · ASRS-RAW · guide 31 · dimensions in mm unless stated
